Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.title: 古惑仔3之隻手遮天
programme.desc: The Hung Hing Club has just made Chan Ho Nam the 'keeper' of Causeway Bay. But, Dong Ying Club, Crow and Tiger open a karaoke club opposite to Chan's sticking a foot into his territory. On the other hand, Dong Ying succeeds in having Chang assassinated in Holland and frames Chan for his death. It's another challenge to Chan.

programme.title: 雌雄大盜
programme.desc: An armed couple breaks in the venue of the world-renowned jewelry designer Yamamoto's exhibition in Tokyo and takes away the most valuable pieces on display. The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.title: 英雄本色II
programme.desc: Former criminal, Tse-Ho is set free from his incarceration in jail to assist in the investigation of his former crime boss, Lung, who is suspected of running a counterfeit operation. Though initially refusing, he only agrees so he can keep a close eye on his cop brother Kit, who is working undercover to infiltrate Lung's organization. After Lung is framed for the murder of a rival gang leader, he turns to Tse-Ho, who helps him escape to New York where he is joined by Ken, the equally deadly twin brother of the deceased Mark. Returning to Hong Kong to rejoin Tse-Ho and Kit, they soon discover the true mastermind behind the entire operation, and in true John Woo fashion, set out to take him down.

programme.title: 龍的傳人
programme.desc: Hung is a Kung-fu coach on Lautau Island. His son Lung and his fellow schoolmate, Mao, are considered a couple. One time, Hung's fellow Yan goes to Lautau for help. Lung knows Yan is not a good guy, however, Hung orders Lung to accompany with Yan to develop his career in the city. Yan discovers that Lung is a talented snooker-player and earns much money from gambling. But Lung loses Hung's land to a group of gangsters in game..

programme.title: 扭計雜牌軍
programme.desc: Four sworn brothers failed heist and get into jail for years. Sheng is set free. The three ask Sheng to get the hidden loot and wait for their eventual reunion. Sheng discovers the loot has disappeared but the other three are convinced Sheng has stolen it. Sheng has to escape. His childhood lover Chuan tries to help him to go overseas but is hurt when Sheng falls for insurance detective Bonnie. Sheng and Bonnie buy tickets from Liang who is left holding the bag when his boss absconds with the money..

programme.title: 誤人子弟
programme.desc: Lam's childhood desire was to become a teacher. After graduating from university, he actually fulfilled his dream and found himself “STAND & DELIVER”, becoming a teacher. When Lam started teaching, he was full of hope and enthusiasm. After three years of experience in the industry, he gradually become stale about his job like the other teachers..

programme.title: 至尊無上之永霸天下
programme.desc: Though persuaded by his brother, Chicken Wing, Kit refused to gamble again. However, Tommy keeps on harassing them, Kit finally decided to take revenge..

programme.title: 三人世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, just breaks up with his model girlfriend Peggy. In order to release Alex's anxiety, his friend invites him to be the part time director of a choir. Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.title: 阮玲玉
programme.desc: Yuan Ling-yu, men looked at her with dreamy eyes and women looked at her sideways and full of hate. And her endings were tragic : mental breakdown, forced marriages and suicide..

programme.title: 師姐大晒
programme.desc: FBI Cindy is ordered to Hong Kong to get the leader of counterfeit banknote manufacturing syndicate, Huang Te. In Hong Kong, Huang goes into the printing business. Ostensibly, he publishes a newspaper. But his real business is still the forgoing of banknotes. Cindy gets a job as the paper's reporter but alert Hong Kong police tell her to keep off. It is their job to get Huang. Cindy happens to know her friend's father is the prosecutor in Huang's trial. She tries to help but Huang gets off by poisoning the prosecutor. Now Cindy is desperate. The police want to see her back in America. She wants to get Huang herself..

programme.title: 小偷阿星
programme.desc: Lung was an informer of Police in the triad society. But his identity was exposed and lost all memory after hurt. All of money that given by the Police was lost. The Police suspicious Lung had hidden the money. So he was wanted by the triad society and Police. Sing was a little thief, he knew Lung and made friend together. He knew everything about Lung then, and he wanted to help Lung to recover his memory aimed to take back the money. Fong was a manger in a big firm. He had stolen a large amount of money of his firm and was discovered by his colleague later. So he wanted to kill Wu but failed. Fong also wanted the money of Lung, as a result, he wanted to kill Lung also. Wu was saved by Lung and Sing. The Boss of Fong knew everything were exposed and ordered Koo to kill Lung, Sing and Wu. But Wu won't do that because of their friendship..

programme.title: 天若有情
programme.desc: Wah Dee handles cars and bikes like a racing champion. To keep the police off his trail, he takes Jo Jo hostage. On the run, their desperate love is doomed from the start...

programme.title: 阿金
programme.desc: Ah Kam is from Mainland China and is trained in kung fu. She becomes a double in Hong Kong. Tung and his partners of the Tung's Family, a stunt man group, cannot work as stuntmen after an ambush. Tung lets Kam try being the stunt director and Kam becomes very popular. Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.title: 致命性騷擾
programme.desc: Office worker Amy goes berserk and tries to stab her boss, Cheuk, accusing him of sexual harassment and rape. The higher-ups accept Amy's description of the event and Cheuk is suspended, in spite of the fact that in-house lawyer Joe believes the man is innocent..

programme.title: 鍾無艷
programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. However, an ugly mole on Wu Yen's face thwarts this match made in heaven. Emperor Qi cancels the wedding for fear of marrying someone ugly. The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power..

programme.title: 誤人子弟
programme.desc: Lam's childhood desire was to become a teacher. After graduating from university, he actually fulfilled his dream and found himself “STAND & DELIVER”, becoming a teacher. When Lam started teaching, he was full of hope and enthusiasm. After three years of experience in the industry, he gradually become stale about his job like the other teachers..

programme.title: 洗黑錢
programme.desc: David is a young lawyer who launders money for a gang leader in Chinatown. He is robbed and his assistant got killed when he carries a large sum of cash to Hong Kong. David turns to Waise, his law school buddy, for help. He doesn't realize that it is Waise who sets up the robbery. Petty, Waise's partner in the law firm, finds out that Waise has conducted some illegal activities. Before she could unveil the truth to the police, Petty is murdered. To cover up the truth, Waise finds Mandy, a promising solicitor, as scapegoat of Petty's death. Waise also sends out a gunman to track down Mandy. In a last minute rescue, Mandy is saved by one of her client, Dragon. She always finds the client obnoxious, but now she has to team up with Dragon to fight back and to prove her innocence at the same time..

programme.title: 師姐大晒

The police want to see her back in America. She wants to get Huang herself..

programme.title: 魔畫情
programme.desc: Leung Chiu Wei and Willy were cartoonists. One day when they were on the way to office, they knocked down a lady-ghost Joey Wong. Joey's spirit was thus thrown into the human world. Joey knew nothing as it was the first time she came to a mundane environment. At this time, she met another demoness – Deanie Yip. Yip and her son were sentenced to death by village people because of adultery. Yip didn't do it but nobody believed her. Yip's only hope was to make her son revive from death. Thus when Yip met Willy, she selfishly kept herself and her son inspired by Willy's human spirit. She also intended to hurt Wei the same as well. Since Joey had fallen in love with Wei, she helped Wei to get away from Yip. Joey became weaker and weaker being hurt by Wei's flourishing human vitality. Wei and Joey in fact were lovers in their previous lives..

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: A member of the Flying Tiger Squad, Sing, is sent to school as an undercover cop to find the Commissioner's lost gun. To Sing, school is nowhere better than jail. He is suffering until he comes across the school teacher Miss Ho. Sing's school life is thus painted with more colours. Finally, Sing settles every problem and succeeds in finding the lost gun. At the Same Time, he destorys a munition smuggling activity. This leads the smugglers to school to take revenge. A group of students is being kept hostage. Sing shows his true colour by saving all the students. This not only wins his students' admiration but also Miss Ho's heart.

programme.title: 最佳拍檔大顯神通
programme.desc: King Kong was attacked by the robot - Black Knight I which was sent by the Italian Mafia to avenge the capture of White Gloves. He also hired an internationally notorious killer Black Gloves to kill King Kong as well as diamond transfer deal with the underworld. King Kong join forces with the police to capture Black Gloves who sends Black Knight II to attack..

programme.title: 至尊計狀元才
programme.desc: As a prominent gambler, Ray has encountered many challenges in his career. When Chiang challenges Ray to a gambling contest with him in Macau, Ray's adventures begins again..

programme.title: 我左眼見到鬼
programme.desc: May marries Daniel during holiday and inherits all money after his death. One night she suffers a fatal car accident. Ken comes to save her life and strange things happen..

programme.title: 花仔多情
programme.desc: Aran is an honest person. He leads an ordinary life and is quite successful with his business. However, when his girlfriend leaves him, chaos begins. He feels depressed and disheartened. Aran finds his friend Ruddy for comfort. Ruddy's sister Connie has always been interested in Aran so Ruddy and his friend contrive a 'trap' for Aran. Aran is forced to marry Connie. Aran and Connie visit Japan for their honeymoon. It is where Aran learns of the scheme and meets Atsuko who really steals his heart..

programme.title: 心動
programme.desc: Ho-jun is a shy youngster, more interested in his guitar than school. A chance encounter between Ho-jun and Sheo-rou leads to a first sweet taste of romance. However..

programme.title: 吳三桂與陳圓圓
programme.desc: Chan Tai Yuen had planned to migrate to Canada, he found out that his wife was having an affair with a foreigner. Chan had already transferred the ownership of the house and the car to his wife. Suddenly Chan lost everything. Chan met Ng Sam Kwi, Chan had nowhere to go and thus moved into Ng's house. They gradually fell in love with each other. Would Ng change herself for her love.

programme.desc: Toy designer Yau is always bullied by boss and ex-girlfriend. One day, Yau runs into a beautiful but rebellious girl named Ching, who tells him she is the target of triad harassment. Yau is determined to help her, and he resigns from his job at the encouragement of Ching. The two take low-pay jobs at a fast-food chain, and gradually fall in love with each other, but their relationship is threatened when Ching's true identity as the daughter of a tycoon is exposed..

programme.desc: Film producer Manfred Wong debuted as a scriptwriter who had been working for various film production companies in Hong Kong. Born in 1950s, he went through the heyday of film industry; witnessed the prosperity of homegrown productions in 1980s to 90s; heard rumor about a superstar being kidnapped to abrupt shooting; but also lamented for decade of steady decline of the city's film industry. Acted as a time witness, he is going to tell us the ups and downs of Hong Kong cinema.

programme.title: 猛龍過江
programme.desc: Chen's restaurant is being targeted by the local mafia. Tang fends off the gangsters and wins her admiration. The mafia boss sends a gunman to kill Tang, but Tang defeats him..

programme.title: 殭屍家族
programme.desc: Antique dealer Kwok roams the countryside with his two assistants searching for rare objects. One day they fall into the cellar of a shrine. There they find three vampires, all rendered harmless by talismans. Kwok takes Sonny Vampire to town, but when the talisman is removed accidentally, the vampire escapes and is being hidden by 6-year-old Chia Chia then. Papa Vampire and Mama Vampire are awakened too when the talismans fall off. Dr. Lin and reporter Ha decide to help stop the vampires from killing people..

programme.title: 影人映語 -李麗珍
programme.desc: Lee Lai Chun, a cinema goddess in the 1980s and 90s, has made her appearances in numerous Hong Kong movies. She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like.

programme.title: 秋天的童話
programme.desc: Lee Kay goes to college in New York City and also to visit her boyfriend Dickson. The one to meet her at the airport is a distant relative Boat Head..

programme.desc: Hong Kong is an over-crowded city, where people are easily provoked with confilcts. Hitman BART and assistant director CHUEN offer a bargain package 'YOU SHOOT, I SHOOT'.

programme.title: 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..

programme.title: 百年好合
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May. The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost 'Heartbreak Sword Technique'..

programme.title: 金三角群英會
programme.desc: BULLET and MOON are two tough ladies who are out to bust the biggest drug syndicate in Thailand and they only have ten days to do it! Nothing is beyond these fighting women as they enter the Golden triangle unafraid because they are on a “MISSION OF JUSTICE”! Through the jungle they pursue the dangerous Yie Feng as they track her into the very heart of Cala. Working under-cover they both find their lives at risk to the deadly Drug Lords. Only their superior fighting skills can keep them from being killed..

programme.title: 旺角卡門
programme.desc: A low-level trial 'big brother' has a hot-tempered 'littler brother' who can't keep out of trouble, and consequently is in constant need of being bailed out by his protector..

programme.title: 賭俠
programme.desc: Little Knife is following in his master's footsteps and rapidly rising in th gambling world. Sing Chi would like to be the God of Gamblers' disciple and ask him for help..

programme.title: 秋天的童話
programme.desc: Lee Kay goes to college in New York City and also to visit her boyfriend Dickson. The one to meet her at the airport is a distant relative Boat Head..

programme.title: 夜生活女王霞姐傳奇
programme.desc: Young Har Jay starts as a waitress in a low-class restaurant. Like all young girls, she falls for handsome young men. One of them makes her pregnant. Determined to keep the baby by all means, Har Jay surrenders herself to police detective Guan who manages to silence the father. Later on, she becomes the head hostess of a cabaret and is famous for the way she trains inexperienced girls. Buwhay, Har Jay's daughter, grows up and revolts. She goes for an upstart mobster, Chao, and runs away from Har Jay..

programme.desc: Since veteran filmmaker Manfred Wong joined the film industry since 1970s and worked for numerous Hong Kong companies at the position from scriptwriter, Head of Promotions to film producer, he has now been the best guide bringing us to travel through a sense of nostalgia for the old days of Hong Kong cinema. In this programme, he tells refinedly that there was a strife between Cantonese and Mandarin movies in 50s and 60s while fierce competitions amongst different film production companies over decades; also how various film companies manifested in the 90s golden era of Hong Kong movies.

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..

programme.title: 君子好逑
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo..

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: The film is originated from a famous Chinese Kung Fu fiction. Everybody fought for a pair of super weapons and wished to be the conqueror..

programme.title: 上海之夜
programme.desc: In 1937, Tung, a young soldier, meet Shu under the Soochow Bridge, Shanghai, where they have been sheltering from the bombing of the city by Japanese planes. In the semi-darkness, though unable to see each other clearly, the young couple experience an immediate attraction towards each other, and plan how to meet again when the war is over..

programme.title: 油尖少爺
programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.

programme.title: 契媽唔易做
programme.desc: A Chinese illegal immigrant “Cousin” wrongly trusted his friend Kwok to rob a jewellery shop. Kwok managed to escape and Cousin is so scared to hide himself in the vehicle which is rented by Ah Ching to remove to the rural area. Ah Ching is suffered by the high pressure from her work and city life. She also has to worry about her boyfriend Fai who is a police inspector. She is determined to pack up and move into remote area to escape from all this. She doesn't know a stranger (Cousin) is right at her back. Ah Ching meets with Pak Lam who is reared in the village by his greedy father Uncle Tat. Ah Ching finds it so ridiculous that naturally she sympathizes the kid. Pak Lam visits Ah Ching's new home to play TV games. He bumped into the scared Cousin who is still hiding there. He and Pak Lam come into an agreement not to reveal his identity to the others. Cousin has no attention to hurt anybody. He even stands out to protect Ah Ching and Pak Lam when the gangs in the village tr.

programme.title: 肥貓流浪記
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a good-natured but mentally retarded adult, is jailed for two years before being bailed out by the Social Welfare Department for good behaviour. Discharges and an orphan, Fat Cat is placed in the custody of a Social Welfare worker Bibi, but there is a communication gap between the two. One day, Bibi takes him to Lantau Island to visit his late parents' grave. As he is crying his heart out, Bibi is involved in a traffic accident, leaving him alone on the Island to lead a wandering life. Seized by cold and hunger at night, Fat Cat tries to steal food from a puppy and is spotted by a stubborn but kind-hearted elder, Granduncle. Failing to find where Fat Cat lives, he takes him home and adopts him. The presence of the simple-minded but optimistic Fat Cat brings much hilarity to the otherwise moribund village. He also wins the elder's favour for resolving the difference between him and his neighbouring youth James, and the three become good friends..

programme.title: 妙探雙龍
programme.desc: Kent was a member of the underground gang in the United States. He was attacked by the gangsters upon holding the key evidence of their criminal offences. Kent had no alternative but to seek FBI's protection. He mailed the crime evidence to his sister in Hong Kong. At the same time, he disguised as a girl and fled to Hong Kong. Here he contacted Mr. Green Village, leader of the underground gang for the selling of the smuggled diamond. His identification was revealed by two CID, Ching Shing and Tai Kau. Kent was brought to the Police Station and put under close supervision. They waited for Cindy, the FBI Officer to extradite him to the States for testimony. Kent escaped before her arrival. At that time, professional killers were sent to search for Kent with the help of Mr. Green Village after bribing him. It started a fatal game of hide and seek among Kent, Cindy, the police and their killers..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 求戀期
programme.desc: The friends of Choi and his girlfriend Mimi always say that the two of them do not look like a couple. So, Choi decides to change his image to be more 'punky'. However, Mimi not only spurns his changes, but also feels there are some problems between them and asks for a break-up. Paul is a 'playboy'. In a rainy night, he meets Yung. She has an unpredictable character. Paul's courtship skills do not work on her. Paul is helpless. Indeed, Yung likes Paul but she is afraid that one day she may really fall in love with Paul so she goes back to Canada. Though unwilling, Paul has to put an end to this relationship.

programme.title: 鬼馬校園
programme.desc: A new school term begins. Vivacious high school girl Jane hurries back to Hong Kong from overseas, where she spent her vacation. Chinese-American college student Wan Ho follows her all the way to Hong Kong to get close to her. But Jane is so popular in school and is used to having boys around her. One of them is Tse Tin, the son of the school director. While Tse Tin and Wan Ho regard each other as rivals and fight over Jane all the time, Jane has developed a crush on the P.E. teacher! Meanwhile, Pak Yat Moon has a crush on Wan Ho, and Ka Ming has crush on Pak Yat Moon! It is a total mess and the relationships become utterly chaotic! Everything culminates in a showdown during a big basketball game..

programme.title: 驅魔警察
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. programme.title: Our Happy Days
programme.desc: A chaotic, high-stakes family saga where a seemingly perfect man and an endearingly flawed woman collide while every generation fights to become the main character of their own life.

programme.title: 最佳的一擊
programme.desc: In the year 1993, K-pop idol Yoo Hyunjae accidentally travels through time to the year 2017. Discovering that he is presumed dead, he begins to investigate what exactly has happened while trying to adjust to life in the 21st century.

programme.title: A Graceful Liar
programme.desc: A bold yet heartbreaking story of a mother and daughter-in-law who meet through marriage and wage a war of lies to seize the Geonhyang family, struggling for a dramatic reversal of fortune.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: The Best Of Immortal Songs
programme.desc: The true classic of the century is born again! The legendary classic is reinterpreted by the best vocalists in Korea. Don't miss out on the heart-moving moments that transcend generations.

programme.title: The Seasons
programme.desc: A talk show brings you music and stories that will 'get rid of all your worries and all your concerns.'.

programme.title: 花郎
programme.desc: Not many people these days know about Hwarang in depth. How did these young men become central to unifying old Korea's Three Kingdoms? Imagine how life must have been for Silla Hwarang in the 6th century.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: This week a heavy rescue like no other – as father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim must rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn. And while Rory moves an antique fire engine for the boss, Fluff must get rid of a lorry load of stinking cheese.

programme.title: Jack Stein: In The Box 第1季
programme.desc: Jack explores the relationship between pork and apples. Then, he hits the streets of Bangkok, and he adds an Asian twist to the British classic pork bun and apple sauce.

programme.title: Fatal Engineering 第1季
programme.desc: Aviation is one of the safest forms of travel—until something goes terribly wrong. This episode of Fatal Engineering dives deep into the stories behind some of the most devastating plane crashes in modern history. Through expert analysis, recreations, and insider accounts, we uncover how small design flaws, rushed procedures, and ignored warnings contributed to catastrophic failures. Discover what really brought these aircraft down—and how those tragedies led to life-saving innovations.

programme.title: Jet Truck 第1季
programme.desc: Chris and Wayner forgo family time between performances to join local racer and wild man, Billy for an afternoon of shooting guns and blowing stuff up, while Brooke's mounting frustration doesn’t fare well for their return.

programme.title: Jet Truck 第1季
programme.desc: The King Of The North drag race kicks off with Billy scrambling to prepare his hotrod for its race against Chris and the Jet Truck, in a challenge that will see the loser facing public humiliation.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: This week a heavy rescue like no other – as father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim must rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn. And while Rory moves an antique fire engine for the boss, Fluff must get rid of a lorry load of stinking cheese.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife 第1季
programme.desc: Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals. The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

programme.desc:
World champion freediver Marina Kazankova is on a mission, to free dive the Great Barrier Reef.

Capable of holding her breath for 7-minutes at a time, Marina travels to the iconic reef, swimming with turtles and giant groper, diving on ship wrecks and through awesome caves, all on a single breath of air.

Capturing each challenge in glorious 4K, this series brings you face to face with the very best of the Great Barrier Reef’s corals and creatures.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Fatal Engineering 第1季
programme.desc: Spanning rivers, canyons, and cities, bridges are symbols of connection and engineering marvels—until they fail catastrophically. Through real footage and expert analysis, we uncover what went wrong, how lives were lost, and how these failures prompted crucial advances in structural engineering and modern safety protocols.

programme.title: Sumatra's Last Tigers 第1季
programme.desc: While tiger populations all around the world are crashing, tiger numbers in a remote nature reserve in Sumatra, Indonesia are increasing. Here even man killers are being rehabilitated and released into the wild. The man behind this unique conservation project is Indonesian tycoon, Tomy Winata. Tomy’s ambitious plan now includes releasing a tiger born in captivity into the wild, will it survive and can the experiment transform conservation practices and save the Sumatran tiger.

學人沙龍
programme.desc: 退休之後，人生是逐漸收束，還是能重新綻放？. 近年，我們常會提到「銀髮族」一詞，這個新的稱謂或許是為了避免冒犯，也可能是將「老去」重新包裝。這究竟是充權行為，還是另一種隱形的壓力？當社會提倡「活躍老化」，一座城市應如何與年老共處？. . 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 蕭欣浩(大學講師). 文潔華(人文學講座教授). . #銀髮族了不起#人生新一頁#孝道#銀髮經濟#自主能力#學人沙龍.

programme.title: 大自然零距離 2
programme.sub-title: 第一集 兩爬 x 夜行 x 薄扶林
programme.desc: 大自然的歡樂時光（happy hour），有着怎樣的風景呢？今集，就讓「兩爬」—兩棲類及爬蟲類動物和大家分享牠們的夜間世界。. 節目邀請生態專家陳文灝(Henry)帶領兩位主持王顥霖(Homan)及王韶昀(Mercury)，由山頂出發，一路沿山徑走落薄扶林水塘。路線由高至低，沿途以森林生境為主，亦有多條溪澗穿插其中。. 今集的兩大目標，是體型修長、潛伏溪澗的中國水龍，以及身形細小、難得一見的香港半葉趾虎。沿途，他們亦會遇上不同的兩爬，觀察牠們的覓食、繁殖與求生智慧。. 除此之外，他們更會尋找夜間開花、香氣迷人的香港木蘭，為這趟夜行探索揭開序幕。. #大自然零距離#兩爬#夜行#薄扶林#夜間生態#中國水龍#香港半葉趾虎#香港木蘭.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #1 腎科教父 - 余宇康教授
programme.desc: 余宇康教授出身醫學世家，父親余朝光醫生曾任廣華醫院院長，其三位兄弟都是醫生，可謂一門多傑。余教授早於六十年代於瑪麗醫院建立首個腎科部門，引入香港第一個腎臟活檢，致力推動洗腎技術，多年來又培育無數腎科專科醫生，桃李滿門，享有「腎科教父」的稱譽。. 余教授一生貢獻醫學界，到現在九十多歲還未言休，每星期仍到律敦治醫院「大巡房」，好讓實習醫生向他學習。行醫路上，這位「教父」始終心繫病人，他說：「醫生首要就是要對病人好。」. 主持：鄧智偉醫生、黃婉曼. 嘉賓：余宇康教授(港大內科學系名譽臨床教授/中大醫學院內科及藥物治療學系榮譽教授/腎病科專科醫生).

programme.title: 棋士
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：過命兄弟為錢鬧絕交
programme.desc: 夏海濤買完彩票回家，夏雨正要出門說飯已做好，卻遇見等候已久的夏生，兩人四目相對。夏生帶夏雨去遊樂園、海邊，在遊戲廳贏了她後說「我們結婚吧」。張校長讓崔業別讓小孩來大師班，專心陪陳主任談生意。崔業資助過的陳曉光來還學費被崔偉拒絕，兩人下棋時崔偉心事重重。夏生見崔業說想拿剩餘的錢開小店好好過日子，崔業聽後只祝福他，沒說原本想說的話。崔業低價賣車後被銷售員介紹高利貸，知曉病情的崔炎高心不在焉只坐棋盤前。崔業算帳時淑華想找工作被拒，崔業說她只需照顧兒子，後發現抵押房子也借不到夠治病的錢。夏雨上班時機器出問題貨物全毀，李姐壓力下欲跳樓，夏生拉住她並讓夏雨找他寄的手牌還債。夏海濤在家收到手牌，高利貸上門催債。走投無路的崔業找夏生借錢，夏生說要幫夏雨還債，兩人爭吵後崔業憤然離去。夏雨回家被夏海濤怒問存折，甩給他後奪手牌出門。崔炎高摔倒，崔業幫他洗澡時他求父親教下棋，說以後站不起來，下棋不用站，崔業心酸險些落淚，最後坐出租車跟蹤高利貸組織.

programme.title: 夢想中華人物誌
programme.sub-title: 樹德立仁—胡鴻烈｜教育｜敦仁博物
programme.desc: 胡鴻烈博士的一生，是學識、風骨與大愛的完美結合。他早年遠赴巴黎和英國，分別取得法學博士學位及大律師資格，其後在香港執業，在司法界備受尊崇.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.sub-title: Episode 5: We are all is one (Indonesia)
programme.desc: One day, the Makapetor team which plays kolintang music, added a member, named Noni. The Makapetor team members rejoiced at the addition of a new member and friend. Keke was no exception. Keke hoped that if there was a new member, then she could take her role in kolintang music by playing melodies while Keke prefers to be a vocalist/singer. . But apparently, the new member, Noni, also has a melodious voice. Keke began to feel competitive with Noni. Keke didn’t like it when Noni became the vocalist in her group. . One day, there was a kolintang music competition. The coach chose Keke as the vocalist, while Noni as the melody player. Both of them really wanted to perform optimally, so even at home they kept practicing until late at night. . Because they were so eager to practice, Keke’s voice was hoarse on the day of the competition. Similarly, Noni got blisters on her hands, because she kept holding the kolintang sticks, even though it was a competition day. After coordinating with the coach, Keke and Noni switched roles. . The Makapetor Team finally won the kolintang competition. This victory is the cooperation of all team members, who complemented and perfected each other. As a team, we should therefore be united.

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.sub-title: Episode 5 “The Spark of Science: The Art of Running A Distinguished Award”
programme.desc: Science progresses rapidly and shapes our future. While fully enjoying the convenience brought by applied technologies, have we ever stopped and thought about whom and what insights the basic science, which laid the foundation for everything, actually originated from?. This episode covers the Future Science Prize 10th Anniversary Special Session, with the theme “How to Run a Successful Prize?”, and where leading global scientists gathered together. “Basic science” explores the origin of the universe, the essence of matter and the life mechanism, which, in spite of being abstract in nature, have far-reaching impacts. On the other hand, “applied science”, just like a relay, continues to transform the results into medical, engineering and electronic technologies, so as to improve human life. Many important scientific awards focus on basic research because it opens up endless possibilities. . How should a scientific award with credibility and long-term impact be operated? In this programme, Professor Anderson Ho-cheung SHUM is invited to be the docent, and listen to the practice wisdom on the selection mechanism, the fairness principle and talent motivation shared by the leading scientists together with the audience. A distinguished award is the key to igniting the spark of science.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: North District: Yulan Season of Love
programme.desc: The “Yulan Festival,” recognized as an item on Hong Kong’s Intangible Cultural Heritage list, expresses stories of different communities and places in diverse ways. Turning off Man Kam To Road into Fu Tei Au Tsuen at the border, one can witness how a group of men, under the scorching sun, organize the three-day Yulan Festival. Not only do they uphold tradition by setting up four statues known as “King of Ghosts” (“Grand Master Ye”), but this year, they have also introduced a special new segment to inject fresh ideas into customary rites. Shifting to another village beside Man Kam To Road, the male organizing committee features the presence of a woman, who is also a member of the Fanling Chiu Kiu Yulan Committee. What stories lie behind this male-dominated scene? Under the blazing sky, besides passing on a sense of care to wandering spirits, what warmth can be found among people on earth.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 卡因迪湖坐落在哈薩克斯坦山脈之中，由山崩形成，一百年來淹沒了一片雲杉森林。樹幹如幽靈般矗立在青碧色的湖水中，其表面覆蓋著神秘的藻類，揭示出湖水下獨特的生態系統。. 自2007年起，卡因迪湖及其周邊森林被納入國家公園範圍，公園旨在保護野生動物免受捕獵，並推動永續旅遊。保育工作使鹿、北山羊及小型哺乳動物數量回升，吸引了狼、熊、豹貓及隱秘的雪豹等大型掠食者回歸。然而，區內冰川的快速融化對這一脆弱的生態平衡構成嚴重威脅。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年7月1日 星期二 晚上10時. . Nestled in Kazakhstan’s mountains, Kaindy Lake, formed by a landslide, has submerged a spruce forest for over a century. The ghostly trunks stands in the middle of electric blue water and are cloaked in enigmatic algae, hinting at a unique underwater ecosystem. . Since 2007, the lake and its surrounding forests have been protected within a national park, which aims to protect wildlife from hunting and promoting sustainable tourism. Conservation efforts have revived populations of deer, ibex, and small mammals, luring back large predators such as wolves, bears, lynx, and elusive snow leopards. However, rapid glacier melting endangers this fragile balance. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.07.01 Tue 10pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 養貓的人
programme.desc: 王天軍在跑車途中收養的小貓們，成為他孤獨運輸路上的忠實夥伴。他們朝夕相處，給貓咪餵食、調解打架、帶看病等生活片段，穿插着他少年喪母的成長創傷。當第一隻收養的貓—福寶突發疾病去世時，王天軍悲痛不已.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 停電了！尋古大師帶小彼德和小賽思來到17世紀的巴黎，當時的照明工具只有燈籠、蠟燭和油燈！自從燈泡出現，社會大大改變了：工時延長，城市街道變得安全……但燈泡的原理是怎樣的？尋古大師把自己縮小，好讓他能進入燈泡裡面，解釋插蘇和燈絲的原理。繼鎢絲燈後，霓虹燈登場，然後就是…節能及環保的LED燈的出現.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 當尋古大師看見一些孩子為溜滑梯爭執時，他藉此機會解釋人類是如何發明了這項遊樂場的經典設施。各式各樣的滑梯相繼被創造出來，讓人們能夠享受滑下時的刺激。尋古大師必須克服恐懼，去挑戰世界上最高的滑梯！然而，滑梯並不僅僅是為了娛樂。例如，它們能在飛機緊急疏散時拯救生命。尋古大師在盡情享受樂趣的同時，也會體會到滑梯實用的一面.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師在彼德和佩莉特協助，向大家介紹製造鋼琴的過程，展示了這種複調弦鳴樂器是如何發展…究竟甚麼是複調？放心，尋古大師自會解釋.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 很多動物都靠著牙齒的力量存活，包括世界上最毒的毒蛇之一——太攀蛇，以及能把骨頭咬得粉碎的河馬BB。這一集「動物童萌」將會帶領觀眾一睹這些動物如何利用驚人牙力去生存.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 老店情未了第二季 (英文版)
programme.desc: Peering down on Stanley Street from the Central–Mid-Levels Escalator, one can see rows of patio umbrellas, under which there are several “dai pai dongs” (open-air eateries). Among them is Sing Kee, a stall with more than seven decades of history that is renowned locally and globally for its stir-fried dishes full of “wok hei” (breath of the wok). . Shing, the owner, wears a white t-shirt as his chef’s whites. He stands in front of two large iron woks, stir-frying various nostalgic Hong Kong dishes with astonishing speed. Pork offal and fresh fish soup with rice are popular heat busters among Central construction workers; sweet and sour pork ribs and salt and pepper squid are Hongkongers’ favourite accompaniments to alcoholic beverages; while steamed seafood and claypot rice are must-orders for foodies from the mainland. . After the lunch service, Shing can finally take a break. Sipping his beer, he recounts the rise and fall of our city’s dai pai dongs.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 惠權集團的股東、董事們向蕭沐恩表達對尹惠權的不滿，蕭沐恩努力平息眾人才作罷。羅江孝提醒尹惠權整項事情有人故意搞事。蕭沐恩珍藏的一部手機收到了故人的來電。李儀棠正坐在返回江城的航班上，而本想和安旎聯繫的她，卻一直無法通話.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 李儀棠到廣東調查老A的背景，返回江城就遇上了蕭沐恩，他將李儀棠騙上車，毫無戒備的李儀棠喝下了蕭沐恩遞過來的水竟倒下了，在失去意識的最後時刻向汪小嬌發送了一條求救微信。另一邊，一場由蕭沐恩策動，罷免尹惠權的鴻門宴正在激烈進行.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：香港中樂團 絲綢之路音樂會
programme.sub-title: 香港中樂團 絲綢之路音樂會
programme.desc: 絲綢之路不單是東西方的商業紐帶，更是文化交融的輝煌路徑，香港中樂團演奏多元民族音樂，跨越千年迴響，更特別邀請越南及新疆兩地的音樂團體參與演出，融合不同的音樂特色，超越文化界限，展現多采多姿的絲路風情樂章。音樂會片段由香港中樂團提供.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台 : 芝麻經理人
programme.desc: 自1786年大受歡迎的占馬勞沙歌劇《芝麻經理人》曾被改編成多個版本並於歐洲各地以不同語言演出，今集《演藝盛薈·開放舞台》會為觀眾帶來香港的首演。. 編劇阮韻珊以改編的粵語對白，與意大利語唱段完美結合，並由香港舞台劇獎最佳導演王俊豪執導，炮製出充滿獨特本土風味的經典嬉笑鬧劇。. 歌劇片段由香港大歌劇院攝製及提供.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳
programme.desc: 舞火龍源自漢代的傳統儀式，在香港大坑和薄扶林村得以延續。蕭昆崙這位薄扶林村的火龍守護者，用雙手將竹篾與香火編織成威武的火龍，延續著這門源自漢代的古老傳統。六十年來，他對舞火龍的熱愛從未減退，不斷精進紥龍技藝。而今，他的兒子蕭震南承襲父親的熱情，父子倆攜手開辦工作坊，傳授製作迷你火龍的技巧。在他們的努力下，薄扶林村的舞火龍傳統煥發新生，在現代社會繼續延燒著傳統文化的火種.

programme.title: 夢想中華人物誌
programme.sub-title: 樹德立仁—胡鴻烈｜教育｜敦仁博物
programme.desc: 胡鴻烈博士的一生，是學識、風骨與大愛的完美結合。他早年遠赴巴黎和英國，分別取得法學博士學位及大律師資格，其後在香港執業，在司法界備受尊崇.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經歷過人生的高低起跌，近年重拾米高峰的江若琳，學懂珍惜及享受得來不易的歌唱事業，更希望與歌迷分享人生感悟，今集《港樂．講樂》江若琳除了帶來新歌《人生是飲飽吃醉》，更重新演繹早期作品《傷情路》，回顧過去、享受當下、前瞻未來。嘉賓主持林智樂亦會為大家送上新歌《The Red Button》。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林智樂. 歌曲：. 江若琳《人生是飲飽吃醉》. 江若琳《傷情路》. 林智樂《The Red Button.

棋士
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：夏雨受重傷昏迷不醒
programme.desc: 夏生和夏雨取出錢箱，在飯店逃生通道點錢，夏雨震驚，夏生說是哥哥留下的。此時崔業找夏生，坦言想幹票大的被拒，夏生勸他重新開始。夏生走後，夏海濤搶走錢箱，夏雨追拉扯被推倒昏迷，手機響起是夏生來電。崔業暗中先發現夏雨並把她手機丟水裏。崔偉在鄲通查案，小丁報告鎖定夏雨收件人；胡奎勇被戳穿後交代夏生寄東西給夏雨。夏雨送急救，崔業安撫絕望夏生。崔業鎖定放貸易叔，租屋觀察，勸夏生合作幹一票讓高利貸自己交錢。夏海濤被高利貸逼問錢來源.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：開國將帥授銜 1955
programme.desc: 影片以1955年9月底全軍第一次實施授銜授勳這個重要的歷史節點為主線，同時將開國領袖們與開國將帥們在不同的革命歷史階段中的閃回穿插其中，充分展示了夾述夾議夾閃回這種重大革命歷史題材影片創作的較為新穎獨特不為多見的敘事風格。既有恢宏的波瀾壯闊的戰爭場面，又有人物生離死別細緻入微的情感表現，二者有機結合產生出了革命的英雄主義與革命的樂觀主義精神。人物個性鮮明栩栩如生，歷史事件真實可信有據可查。濃縮展示了中國人民解放軍自八一南昌起義之後的歷史篇章.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「病從口入」相信大家都聽過這句說話，但食物中毒卻常在我們日常生活中被忽略。根據衛生防護中心的數字，2025年就有129宗食物中毒個案，受影響人數達到682人；而今年截至5月11日，食物中毒個案75宗，受影響人數已達到262人，當中細菌及病毒感染是導致食物中毒的主要原因。. 今集節目將會為大家探討一些經常導致食物中毒的病原體，以及它們常在哪些食物出沒，好讓大家減低食物中毒的風險。. 主持：黃婉曼、董光達醫生. 嘉賓：薛詠珊醫生(中大醫學院賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院副教授(臨床)).

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 音樂教育是提升素養的階梯，還是基層孩子遙不可及的夢想？. 音樂教師郭小櫻相信每個人都有接觸美妙旋律的權利。憑著「音樂無界限」的初心，她與拍檔Otto羅子韜共同創立了音樂義教組織，透過招募志同道合的導師，為社區內不同階層的兒童提供義教，範疇涵蓋鋼琴、小提琴及聲樂等等。. 除了課室內的知識傳承，他們也積極推廣樂器捐贈計畫，更發起「共享鋼琴」行動，將捐贈得到的鋼琴放置在社區角落，讓悠揚琴聲走進街頭巷尾。在這裡，音樂化作一種流動的能量，連結起陌生的人群.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：興傑決心為林場找到新出路
programme.desc: 長山對興傑說自己看出曉晴不悅，勸興傑以二人家庭為重，興傑說兆喜自強的山貨錢還沒還呢，長山叮囑他不能背這個包袱，趕快跟著曉晴回廣深。興傑卻早已下定決心抗起責任。興傑和林恒倆翁婿進行談話，興傑則反思，他想為這片土地找到新出路。林恒、曉晴聽後動容.

唐朝詭事錄
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集: 參天樓 (3)
programme.desc: 盧凌風讓喜君繪製出了沙斯舊情人賀蘭雪的樣貌，盧凌風想以這個人作為突破口。蘇無名與盧凌風推敲《沙斯傳》的作者，他們鎖定了一名現任官員王元通。盧凌風前往鬼市的幽怨樓找賀蘭雪，蘇無名則去會王元通。王元通軟硬不吃，對沙斯隻字不提.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集: 參天樓(4)
programme.desc: 盧凌風試探賀蘭雪，卻發現此女心機極深，很快看破了他的意圖。盧凌風本打算埋伏起來，借機誅殺可能來此的沙斯，同時間長史杜銘射也準備捉拿沙斯…參天樓設計者宇文慕愷突然遭殺害，蘇盧二人找到重要遺物。參天樓幻術大會如期舉行，天子親臨，公主與太子陪同左右.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經歷過人生的高低起跌，近年重拾米高峰的江若琳，學懂珍惜及享受得來不易的歌唱事業，更希望與歌迷分享人生感悟，今集《港樂．講樂》江若琳除了帶來新歌《人生是飲飽吃醉》，更重新演繹早期作品《傷情路》，回顧過去、享受當下、前瞻未來。嘉賓主持林智樂亦會為大家送上新歌《The Red Button》。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林智樂. 歌曲：. 江若琳《人生是飲飽吃醉》. 江若琳《傷情路》. 林智樂《The Red Button.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥家裡的燈突然熄滅，他請蛋仔打開檯燈，但電力未恢復。於是他們前往光線充足的史前世界，尋找藍水晶來為蛋仔充電，最終成功讓洞穴變得美麗。回家後，小麥變得更加鎮定，小米和蛋仔陪伴著他.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 在炎熱的夏天，小麥想去冰川世界，但低估了寒冷。小米提醒他多穿外套，他拒絕了。到達後，大家因寒冷凍僵，木瓜用擁抱救了朋友們。回家後，小麥為未聽小米的話道歉，姐弟倆重歸於好.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 杜老師帶全班到後海看流星雨，卻發現隕石朝他們飛來！杜老師組織撤離，如福和榮老闆展開拔河賽。菲菲讓脊獸們合力擊碎隕石，碎片掉落後海，避免災難.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 顧拜為了避開小杜的監視，困住了他，小杜失控衝出教室。菲菲召集如福侍衛隊去找小杜，卻發現維修中心關門了。雖然小杜未能修好，但兩人認清了在課堂上打鬧的錯誤.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.desc: 牛大媽正式搬進養老中心，把省錢的習慣也帶來了，鬧了不少笑話。為了養老用地批文，孫前程咬咬牙，同意招收更多老人入住，這下新城集團大批退休職工就都住進來了，一時間養老中心熱鬧了起來.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 這件來自四千多年前龍山文化的蛋殼黑陶高柄杯，黑如漆、亮如鏡，輕巧纖薄得令人驚嘆。它被世界考古學界譽為「四千年前地球文明最精緻之作」，工藝極致，至今仍無法被完美複製，是史前頂尖科技的巔峰象徵，展現了中華遠古匠人的超凡智慧.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 天星小輪的船笛聲、電車的叮叮聲、雪糕車的音樂聲，這些熟悉的聲響不只是日常背景，更是刻進城裡的文化符號，交織出香港獨有的生活韻律。兒童繪本作家 Liudmila 透過童趣視角，引導孩子以耳朵探索城市，將平凡街頭幻化為聽覺冒險；而除了環境聲，人聲更是組成這個城市不可或缺的元素；梁少霞Sharon 以超過三十年的配音生涯，陪伴了幾代香港人的童年；廖浩賢則以極速的講馬旁述，展現出香港最地道的一面。. 這些往往被忽略的聲音，實則承載著厚實的集體記憶。節目將帶領觀眾撥開都市喧囂，重新發現隱藏其中的美妙旋律，聽見最地道的香港色彩.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 地球大堡礁
programme.sub-title: 復育珊瑚礁 Resurrecting The Reef
programme.desc: 過去三十年間，全球損失了差不多三分之一珊瑚礁。超過十億人依賴珊瑚礁提供食物；數十萬人全靠珊瑚礁維持生計，因此，復育珊瑚礁成為科學家關心的課題。. 本節目第二集，以精心拍攝的珍貴影像，詳述珊瑚面臨的生存挑戰，包括健康惡化，繁殖因難，面對天敵等等，當然箇中因由少不了氣候變化的影響。引入科技協助珊瑚繁殖，澳洲大堡礁的復育經驗，也許可以惠及世上其他珊瑚國度。. Over the past 30 years, the world has lost nearly one-third of its coral reefs.More than one billion people depand on reefs for food and hunderds of thousands of people depend on them for their livelihoods. From the most recently developed killer robots to shellfish farming, ultra-modern tactics are now proving their worth in the Great Barrier Reef to ensure the survival of this natural wonder that is the coral world and to make it possible to export this know-how to many of the world’s reefs.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：興傑決心為林場找到新出路
programme.desc: 長山對興傑說自己看出曉晴不悅，勸興傑以二人家庭為重，興傑說兆喜自強的山貨錢還沒還呢，長山叮囑他不能背這個包袱，趕快跟著曉晴回廣深。興傑卻早已下定決心抗起責任。興傑和林恒倆翁婿進行談話，興傑則反思，他想為這片土地找到新出路。林恒、曉晴聽後動容.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 省教育整頓駐點指導小組下沉京海進行教育整頓工作，決定從京海市政協副主席龔開疆入手。徐忠、紀澤在自查自糾表中發現安欣表格填寫詳細，游泳池單獨約見他。安欣與依指導小組要求講述了他與高啟強相識的經過。2000 年，大年三十，安高二人正式相識.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：興傑對曉晴說想回鄉創業
programme.desc: 爺爺血壓高暈倒，興傑不放心多留兩天，順便在林場進行調研考察，曉晴不滿。鳳勤告訴興傑自己要先學知識再回來造福山林，點醒了興傑。馬曉雲在存花家發現了蛇，工人們撒藥驅蛇，山意識到林場確實不再適合居住，動了答應搬遷的念頭。興傑回到廣深，對曉晴說想回鄉創業.

唐朝詭事錄
programme.sub-title: 第三十六集: 參天樓(5)
programme.desc: 幻術大會突生變故，大批怪鳥來襲，直奔天子、太子和公主，盧凌風追擊沙斯，蘇無名揭開沙斯的真實身份！蘇盧二人能否守護大唐的盛世?[全劇完.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第一集：羅英子遭遇婚姻背叛
programme.desc: 羅英子生活在涇北市，和丈夫劉銘過著幸福快樂的生活。28歲時，羅英子通過了司法考試並取得了律師資格證，正當她以為生活會一直這樣美滿之際，卻在她準備為老公劉銘慶祝30歲生日的當天，意外收到了劉銘和閨蜜溫莉合夥轉移所有財產並逃往國外的消息，讓她大受打擊.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米在房間裡炫耀自己的閱讀能力，並與正在學習的小麥比較。小麥則抱怨自己跑得最快。兩人收到恐龍朋友的邀請，參加小型運動會，每隻恐龍展示特長。小麥和小米也參加了比賽，但小米因不擅長運動而感到沮喪。最終，她明白到，獲勝不如在過程中享受樂趣.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥因下雨失落，小米帶他去史前世界。那裏炎熱，他們決定去海邊游泳。奶昔分享了珍珠，小麥因無法潛水感到沮喪，但最終決定加入朋友們的玩耍，明白與朋友在一起才是最重要的.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 大桔送作業本到學校，卻被杜老師誤以為是玩具，鎖在儲物櫃裡。菲菲召喚如福解救大桔，但幾次嘗試後，大桔被杜老師塞進紙箱，鎖在櫃子裡，準備學期結束後再還給菲菲.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 周末社區舉辦廚藝大賽，菲菲嫲嫲和富貴嫲嫲鬥氣，決定參賽。菲菲想打探其他選手的狀況，朝風趁機將能讓物體膨脹的千年蓼花發酵粉灑進了嫲嫲的麵團裏.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：陳新城決定正式接管養老中心
programme.desc: 陳新城決定正式接管養老中心，發揮餘熱。肖長慶和孫前程心裏都不痛快了。二人不甘心，決定跟陳新城對着幹，把養老中心日常的雞毛蒜皮的事向陳新城匯報.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 顏卓彬六歲時開始接受足球訓練的彬仔，今年受球會青島海牛青睐，正式登上中超舞台！今集會帶大家了解彬仔的訓練實況，以及認識青島海牛這隊中超球隊！當然也少不了和觀眾近距離欣賞中超球賽，更會窺探一下彬仔在假期時的私生活！還有大國腳曲波對一眾闖中超的香港球員的寄語.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 匠心傳承
programme.desc: 本集將橫跨美國，從加州海岸到南方低地，尋訪追求完美的頂尖工匠。由鄉村音樂靈魂的木結他、洋溢海岸風情的木製衝浪板，到極具美國特色的牛仔帽；從名釀波本威士忌、芝加哥霓虹燈牌到傳承非裔文化的草織籃，處處展現美國多元的創意靈魂。這群工匠與他們的祖先一樣，懷著開拓精神，以雙手譜寫未來的歷史，讓古老工藝在現代煥發新生命力。. America Made with Love journeys from coast to coast, spotlighting the ingenuity, vision, and unparalleled talent of some of the nation´s most extraordinary artisans. From a masterful cowboy bootmaker to a jewellery artists crafting pieces inspired by Indigenous ancestry, these stories celebrate creativity rooted in tradition and passion. Whether sculpting handcrafted baseball bats, hammering copper, catching lobsters, or perfecting the art of cheesemaking, these makers embody the very essence of American innovation and dedication.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：興傑對曉晴說想回鄉創業
programme.desc: 爺爺血壓高暈倒，興傑不放心多留兩天，順便在林場進行調研考察，曉晴不滿。鳳勤告訴興傑自己要先學知識再回來造福山林，點醒了興傑。馬曉雲在存花家發現了蛇，工人們撒藥驅蛇，山意識到林場確實不再適合居住，動了答應搬遷的念頭。興傑回到廣深，對曉晴說想回鄉創業.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：陳新城決定正式接管養老中心
programme.desc: 陳新城決定正式接管養老中心，發揮餘熱。肖長慶和孫前程心裏都不痛快了。二人不甘心，決定跟陳新城對着幹，把養老中心日常的雞毛蒜皮的事向陳新城匯報.

programme.title: 大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 顏卓彬六歲時開始接受足球訓練的彬仔，今年受球會青島海牛青睐，正式登上中超舞台！今集會帶大家了解彬仔的訓練實況，以及認識青島海牛這隊中超球隊！當然也少不了和觀眾近距離欣賞中超球賽，更會窺探一下彬仔在假期時的私生活！還有大國腳曲波對一眾闖中超的香港球員的寄語.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 2021年，徐忠、紀澤結束與安欣的第一次面談後，暫時還互不信任。高啟強知道指導組來，刻意安排掃了幾場自家的場給成績。徐忠和紀澤來找安欣了解狀況，安欣對數次派人下來調查的結果不抱太大信心，徐忠告訴他，他們這次就是要來除根的，徐忠的話觸動了安欣.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米在房間裡炫耀自己的閱讀能力，並與正在學習的小麥比較。小麥則抱怨自己跑得最快。兩人收到恐龍朋友的邀請，參加小型運動會，每隻恐龍展示特長。小麥和小米也參加了比賽，但小米因不擅長運動而感到沮喪。最終，她明白到，獲勝不如在過程中享受樂趣.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥因下雨失落，小米帶他去史前世界。那裏炎熱，他們決定去海邊游泳。奶昔分享了珍珠，小麥因無法潛水感到沮喪，但最終決定加入朋友們的玩耍，明白與朋友在一起才是最重要的.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 大桔送作業本到學校，卻被杜老師誤以為是玩具，鎖在儲物櫃裡。菲菲召喚如福解救大桔，但幾次嘗試後，大桔被杜老師塞進紙箱，鎖在櫃子裡，準備學期結束後再還給菲菲.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 周末社區舉辦廚藝大賽，菲菲嫲嫲和富貴嫲嫲鬥氣，決定參賽。菲菲想打探其他選手的狀況，朝風趁機將能讓物體膨脹的千年蓼花發酵粉灑進了嫲嫲的麵團裏.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：興傑和自強創辦山貨公司
programme.desc: 興傑把開辦公司給鄉親們解決經濟來源的想法彙報給林恒，林恒聽說公司能夠解決工人們往後的生計問題，一口答應幫大家想辦法批地創辦工廠。興傑和自強的山貨公司就此創辦起來。鳳勤高考，報考了東北林業大學。馬曉雲陪著鳳勤出發去大學。興傑、自強、易航成立大森林公司.

生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第二集：羅英子接手王大福案
programme.desc: 羅英子去了找温莉男友王良和自己的公婆，發現原來劉銘的背叛是和公婆蓄謀已久的。她只能拜託公婆家的保母蘭蘭把兩間在她名下房子的房產證從公婆家找出來。同時，羅英子剛到職良誠律師事務所，積極向師父韓之通爭取嘗試獨立辦理案件，老韓將王大福殺人案交予羅英子接手.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三集：劉銘巨額債務連累羅英子
programme.desc: 韓之通催促羅英子寫好辯護詞，然而羅英子在會見當事人後，認為王大福案有可疑，決定要用剩餘的時間調查當事人沒有殺人的證據。此時，羅英子收到丈夫劉銘巨額欠債的追討，質問公婆劉銘借私人貸的事，卻碰冷釘子。她將事情告知師姐邱華，並拜託她幫忙尋找王大福案的證據.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米和小麥在寵物雞嬌嬌的窩裡發現一顆蛋，帶著小雞回到史前時代。姐弟倆在恐龍廣場尋找蛋的失主，拜訪多位恐龍朋友，卻無法找到。正當失去信心時，小恐龍破殼而出.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米和茜茜在後院踢毽子，沒有帶小麥。小麥接到恐龍召喚後加入。在史前世界，胖殼感到身份危機，哭著跑開。朋友們找到他，讓他感受到歸屬感。回家後，小米和茜茜邀請小麥一起玩，大家都很開心.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集《小農夫大作物新一彈》帶觀眾到訪札幌市手稻區的一間豆腐店。究竟多優質和精緻的豆腐，才能獲得日本第一的美譽？主持們亦會介紹各款健康的豆腐菜式，例如以豆渣代替肉碎的麻婆豆腐.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.sub-title: 第十二集：孫前程女兒幾乎訣別
programme.desc: 孫前程突然接到女兒曉晴電話，電話中曉晴幾乎訣別，孫前程徹底慌了。眾人盲目尋找，無異於大海撈針。肖長慶騎着三輪車，帶着陳新城穿梭在大街小巷，終於在一座橋上找到了曉晴，曉晴面如死灰，深深地望着橋下的河水.

programme.title: 路政同行四十載
programme.sub-title: 路政同行四十載 - 通港連城
programme.desc: 有人的地方，就有路；道路乃城市的經脈，連繫生活，為發展注入動力。. 香港的道路和鐵路網絡四通八達，各項基建工程，為城市和經濟發展打好基礎。四十年來，路政署一直堅守專業創新精神，從青馬大橋、汀九橋，連接內地的高鐵和港珠澳大橋，以至剛通車的中九龍繞道、未來的港深西部鐵路，都與香港發展並肩同行，成就生活每一步.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 2021年，安欣帶著徐忠、紀澤來到高啟強的老宅，徐忠問如果回到當年是不是還會給高啟強送年夜飯，安欣認為不一定，所有選擇都是當下的。2000年，安欣因和瘋驢子衝突被關禁閉。安欣將過錯攬在身上，瘋驢子邀請他和自己混。出了拘留所，瘋驢子懷疑安欣是警察.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：鳳菊去探監見兆喜
programme.desc: 搬遷之後，大家不習慣。梁富寬在家眼紅徒弟劉鐵軍在大森林公司當副總，找興傑要當主管，可偷懶被開除，出去開計程車。而興傑讓大家用職位換股份，解決了公司的人情問題。鳳菊收到兆喜的項鏈高興地去探監。兆喜說叫寄鳳菊賣項鏈換錢，他怕鳳菊一個人在省城不安全.

無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第四集：邱華和羅英子親自去取證
programme.desc: 羅英子找到了放貸公司的周老闆，提出可以賣房還債，但也要求對方不可再滾利息和不許上門討債的要求。經過談判後，周老闆同意了她的要求。事情處理完後，羅英子再跟邱華一同到村尋找王大福案的線索。在她們的一番努力下，終於找到了可以證明王大福沒有殺人的證據.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第五集：羅英子被韓之通搶功勞
programme.desc: 羅英子賣房找到了買家，發現買方原來就是周老闆。羅英子馬上親切起來，主動讓價四十萬並提出了三個條件，周老闆爽快答應。另一邊，邱華把找到證據一事告知韓之通，韓之通聽後，態度馬上變了，在羅英子不知情下，讓邱華去法庭申辦律師更換手續，決定帶邱華親自出庭.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥急於品嚐蛋糕，但被燙到。姐弟倆前往史前世界，遇到雷卡，他在等待恐龍蛋孵化。他們嘗試用樹葉和朋友幫助，但都失敗了，後來享受與奶昔打球的樂趣。不久，雷卡的恐龍弟弟破殼而出，大家熱烈慶祝.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥和小米邊吃爆谷邊看恐龍電影，但不甘心去睡。小麥偷偷跑到史前時代，讓大家四處尋找他。最終，小米聽見呼救，帶大家找到小麥，但意外掉進火山，哆來咪飛起來救出他們.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集主持人會學習以北海道食材，製作豆沙餡料。豆沙餡的款式包羅萬有，有粒粒豆沙、綿滑豆沙，亦有分紅豆製和白腰豆製的！另外，他們還嘗試製作豆沙包，不知味道如何呢.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：孫前程回顧自己人生

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 晚上，小米發現小麥不見了，驚慌地四處尋找，卻無法找到他。被自己的尖叫驚醒的小麥安慰她，姐弟倆決定去恐龍世界。那裡朋友們圍著營火講故事，分享美好的夢。小米聽完後感到放鬆，決定講述自己在無盡圖書館的夢。蛋仔提醒他們該回家了，鼓勵珍藏美好回憶。小米心滿意足地入睡，臉上帶著微笑.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記

Their daughter thinks of saving and saves, but their son Tashi does not take much interest in saving and uses the money. Later on, he learns the importance of saving.

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: An annual mega event for the scientific community, the Future Science Prize Award Ceremony, was successfully held for the third time in Hong Kong. Three grand prizes – Life Science Prize, Physical Science Prize, and Mathematics and Computer Science Prize were successfully awarded to seven scientists. . As in previous years, the Award Ceremony came with the Future Science Prize Week events where elites in the scientific community from around the world gathered together, including several Nobel Prize laureates. During the 5-day events such as the Science Symposiums, Science and Technology Forum, and Asian Young Scientist Fellowship Annual Conference, the elites gathered together for mutual interaction and exchange. . In order to popularise science at all levels and inspire young people, the organiser held multiple science popularisation events hosted by laureates to share their journeys of scientific research and expose young people and the public to science closely.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.desc: In the summer of 2023, a baby kitten was found in the middle of a corridor in a secondary school. The saved kitten was named Chester. As a result, a cat lounge was set up in the school, which also became home to two more adopted cats: Chloe and Natalie. The trio from then on became cat teachers of the school, giving lessons on life education to students as well as teachers.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 面對毫無頭緒的李儀棠被害案，安旎和何陸源決定跟着李儀棠的腳步，親自遠赴廣州一趟。二人找到七婆探查線索。周斯越的過往浮出水面。根據李儀棠手機照片裏存儲的電話號碼，安旎等人鎖定到了可疑的機主，卻發現居然是精心搭建的虛擬網絡設備.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 蕭沐恩登門拜訪尹惠權，公然挑釁並訴說了兩個人的前世今生、周斯越的身份。另一邊，安旎終於知曉，蕭沐恩只是一個他為自己取的花名。經過眾人的努力，也終於確定了蕭沐恩的真實身份就是那個與電詐集團相關.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 我們常說一個畫面「唯美」，又會說一段愛情「淒美」。這兩個形容詞很接近：都有「美」，同樣帶有藝術感。難道一朵花最令人觸動，往往不是盛放之時，而是快凋謝的一刻？細閱文學、藝術史，主持們詳談兩種不同的審美機制。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 蕭欣浩(大學講師). 文潔華(人文學講座教授). #淒美#唯美主義#平衡與對稱#傷感美學#學人沙龍.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 在菲律賓群島中心地帶的保和島是獨特的地質瑰寶。每年在十二月至五月的旱季期間，山丘上的草會變成朱古力的棕色，構成了標誌性的「巧克力山」，與四周雨林的翠綠色形成鮮明對比。. 由於地質及板塊活動歷史，保和島擁有非常多樣化的動植物群。當地擁有的稀有物種包括能在樹間滑翔的鼯猴、翼展超過1.5米的的大型蝙蝠—菲律賓果蝠，與及菲律賓眼鏡猴。不幸的是，當地獨特的生態系統正面對著森林砍伐、偷獵及氣候變化的嚴重威脅。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年7月8日 星期二 晚上10時. . In the heart of the Philippine archipelago lies Bohol Island, a geological gem known for its unique features. Its grassy hills transform into a "chocolate brown" hue during the dry season from December to May, resulting in the iconic Chocolate Hills and creating a striking contrast with the lush green rainforest surrounding them. . Bohol boasts a diverse array of flora and fauna due to its complex geological and tectonic history. Among its rare species are the colugo, which glides gracefully between trees; the giant golden-crowned flying fox, with a wingspan exceeding 1.5 meters; and the Philippine tarsier. Unfortunately, these unique ecosystems are now under serious threat from deforestation, poaching, and climate change. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.07.08 Tue 10pm.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：本地樂團．舒曼全集
programme.desc: 舒曼的音樂經歷了古典時期與浪漫時期的轉變，不僅延續了貝多芬及海頓的傳統，更為後來的布拉姆斯和德伏扎克鋪路。本地樂團藝術總監兼⾸席指揮林屴汧透過舒曼的曲目，帶領觀眾欣賞德奧時期浪漫派的古典管弦樂。音樂會片段由本地樂團提供。. 表演曲目. 曼弗雷德序曲. a⼩調鋼琴協奏曲（獨奏：王應淳）. d⼩調第四交響曲.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳：名家導讀
programme.desc: 守藝薪傳名家導賞版，麥勁生教授將帶大家欣賞中國傳統文化，本集會聚焦於：書法和印章雕刻。. 書法，中國傳統六藝之一，承載著千年文化的精髓。香港書法師傅華戈的字跡遍布商場和酒店，並在香港電影中獲得青睞。他的風格靈活多變，徒弟Heidi自四歲開始學習書法，並希望為這門藝術注入新意，探索書法的無限可能。. 印章雕刻藝術源遠流長，至今仍在香港的「圖章街」盛行。吳錦泉師傅四十多年來專注雕刻，最近開始免費教授，希望找到傳承人。徒弟Winnie從普通顧客轉變為徒弟，通過雕刻圖章，她不僅學會了手藝，還發現了這是一種治癒的藝術.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經歷過人生的高低起跌，近年重拾米高峰的江若琳，學懂珍惜及享受得來不易的歌唱事業，更希望與歌迷分享人生感悟，今集《港樂．講樂》江若琳除了帶來新歌《人生是飲飽吃醉》，更重新演繹早期作品《傷情路》，回顧過去、享受當下、前瞻未來。嘉賓主持林智樂亦會為大家送上新歌《The Red Button》。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林智樂. 歌曲：. 江若琳《人生是飲飽吃醉》. 江若琳《傷情路》. 林智樂《The Red Button.

大自然零距離 2
programme.sub-title: 第二集 蝴蝶 x 寄主植物 x 鳳園
programme.desc: 蝴蝶色彩斑斕，姿態優美，往往是許多人認識大自然的第一道入口。無論在市區還是郊野，都不難發現牠們的蹤影。. 今集來到大埔鳳園。這個距離市區不遠的地方，原來是香港重要的蝴蝶保育區。在鳳園專家趙玉蓮(Colleen)及黃嘉麟(Smith)的帶領下，主持王曉欣(Ivy)及王顥霖(Homan)走入區內不同生境，尋找幾種較罕見的蝴蝶，包括豹斑雙尾灰蝶、曲紋稻弄蝶，以及大絹斑蝶。過程中，他們不僅認識蝴蝶與寄主植物之間密不可分的生命關係，亦了解到一個小小的保育區，如何透過長年累月的植物管理、生境復育與保育工作，在城市邊緣為生物多樣性保留一片重要空間。. #大自然零距離#蝴蝶#寄主植物#鳳園#蝴蝶保育區#豹斑雙尾灰蝶#曲紋稻弄蝶#大絹斑蝶.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #2 粉紅力量 - 張淑儀醫生
programme.desc: 本港每 13 名女性就有 1 人有機會患上乳癌，重擊患者身心。早於80 年代，張淑儀醫生率先引入乳房重建及局部切除手術，在保守的年代喚醒守護女性健康的「粉紅力量」，不單拯救生命，更捍衛了患者的尊嚴，張醫生憶記：「有一天，第一位接受局部乳房切除的患者告訴我，她很開心可以到內衣店自由選擇想要的內衣。我覺得這項服務非常值得！」. 為了對抗乳癌，張醫生開創了不少先河，包括推動全港第一個乳癌普查計劃，並成立本地首個專注於乳房健康教育及研究、患者支援的非牟利慈善組織「香港乳癌基金會」。張醫生更建立逾三萬人數據的本地首個「乳癌資料庫」，好讓醫學界和政策制定者能以大規模本地數據作為決策基礎，期望可推動更普及的乳癌篩查有。令前局長高永文醫生都多次參與乳癌基金會的活動，對張醫生給予支持。. 張醫生憑著多年來的毅力，匯聚了各方人士去支持這股粉紅力量，目的始終心繫病人：「我們不只是醫治病症，而是醫治整個人，醫治到她的心。」. 主持：鄭萃雯、胡志遠醫生. 嘉賓：張淑儀醫生（香港乳癌基金會創會人.

programme.sub-title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇製作特輯-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.desc: 「全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮暨主題講座」，由香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會(國安委)主辦。香港電台除了負責直播之外，亦就當中的青少年短劇表演製作特輯。. 同學隨參訪團參觀內地及香港與抗戰相關的地點，深入了解到先輩在抗日戰爭中所展現的偉大抗戰精神，並將體會融入短劇演出中，呈現中國共產黨領導的東江縱隊在抗日戰爭中的英勇事跡，表達對國家安全的理解及愛國情懷。節目旨在提升市民的國家安全意識，並以深入淺出的方式讓市民明白國家安全的重要性、全面性，以及國家安全與全港每一位市民的密切關係.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 這件來自四千多年前龍山文化的蛋殼黑陶高柄杯，黑如漆、亮如鏡，輕巧纖薄得令人驚嘆。它被世界考古學界譽為「四千年前地球文明最精緻之作」，工藝極致，至今仍無法被完美複製，是史前頂尖科技的巔峰象徵，展現了中華遠古匠人的超凡智慧.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 天星小輪的船笛聲、電車的叮叮聲、雪糕車的音樂聲，這些熟悉的聲響不只是日常背景，更是刻進城裡的文化符號，交織出香港獨有的生活韻律。兒童繪本作家 Liudmila 透過童趣視角，引導孩子以耳朵探索城市，將平凡街頭幻化為聽覺冒險；而除了環境聲，人聲更是組成這個城市不可或缺的元素；梁少霞Sharon 以超過三十年的配音生涯，陪伴了幾代香港人的童年；廖浩賢則以極速的講馬旁述，展現出香港最地道的一面。. 這些往往被忽略的聲音，實則承載著厚實的集體記憶。節目將帶領觀眾撥開都市喧囂，重新發現隱藏其中的美妙旋律，聽見最地道的香港色彩.

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: An annual mega event for the scientific community, the Future Science Prize Award Ceremony, was successfully held for the third time in Hong Kong. Three grand prizes – Life Science Prize, Physical Science Prize, and Mathematics and Computer Science Prize were successfully awarded to seven scientists. . As in previous years, the Award Ceremony came with the Future Science Prize Week events where elites in the scientific community from around the world gathered together, including several Nobel Prize laureates. During the 5-day events such as the Science Symposiums, Science and Technology Forum, and Asian Young Scientist Fellowship Annual Conference, the elites gathered together for mutual interaction and exchange. . In order to popularise science at all levels and inspire young people, the organiser held multiple science popularisation events hosted by laureates to share their journeys of scientific research and expose young people and the public to science closely.

programme.title: 相會雙城
programme.sub-title: 相會雙城 - 咫尺之情 (上)
programme.desc: 這是一個跨越七十年的故事：相會於上海與香港之間，亦連繫着家鄉寧波奉化的記憶與延續。. 五十年代初，上海解放後，很多人帶着資金及技術湧入香港，當時26歲的張子斌在上海學得一手紅幫裁縫技藝，為了生計，他帶着僅有的十元美金前往香港打拼。張子斌在香港落地生根，開設男士訂制服裝店Ascot Chang，以穩妥的品質建立口碑，也為日後的傳承奠定根基。. 七十年代末，張子斌身體抱恙，召回留學美國、剛剛大學畢業的兒子張宗琪（Tony）協助打理業務。原本對裁縫一竅不通的Tony，一做便做了四十多年。他秉承爸爸對品質的堅持、技術的追求，緊緊追隨爸爸的足跡。. 九十年代，當內地改革開放帶來新機遇， Tony回到父親學藝的上海開設內地第一間分店，希望把家族事業帶到更廣闊的地方。同時，他亦延續爸爸回饋家鄉的善行，在爸爸的出生地寧波奉化為鄉鎮的小學捐錢興建新教學樓。. 為了拉近下一代與家鄉的距離，Tony安排兒子張奕庭（Justin）暑假期間到家鄉奉化的農村小學當小老師，教授英文，讓Justin在日常相處中理解回鄉的意義。近年，他又以修葺祖墳作為起點，希望家族可以有一個回鄉聚首的地方。這份相會不只停留在上海與香港，更在寧波奉化的土地上，延續成一種長久的連結.

programme.title: 林則徐：虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: This episode turns to a lesser-told legacy: Lin Zexu’s mastery of water. In 1841, the Yellow River burst its banks. Exiled and en route, Lin was urgently summoned to Kaifeng to lead the response. In Zhangwan Village, Henan, the “Lin Gong Dyke” still stands as a silent witness. Through villagers’ memories and historians’ insights, the episode returns to that moment and shows how a man condemned as a “disgraced official” led the fight against the flood. . From there, the story moves to Fuzhou, his birthplace. His descendants recall two “heirlooms” and the family maxims known as the “Ten Things That Do No Good,” offering a window onto the frugal household codes that shaped his probity and sense of duty.

programme.title: 老派小店之必要
programme.desc: 人們總會對一些看似陰森的事物敬而遠之。紙紮店便是其中一例。紙紮店，的確散發著一股古老而神秘的氣息，讓人不自覺地產生一絲恐慌。很多人都當作是祭祀的象徵，但其實紙紮鋪亦充滿人情味。而紮作師傅的作品，就好像一道橋將兩個截然不同的世界無縫連接。.

programme.title: 勝在有設計
